thread:
maria (product): Quick sync request — we need to settle on client-visible phrasing for non-blocking failovers (soft fallback to cheaper/compatible model) and the telemetry tags we show in the console. Can we decide today?

sam (eng-platform): yes. main tradeoffs: transparent vs noisy. We want clients to understand it's a graceful degrade (not an error) but still be able to surface it in dashboards and alerts.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime already emits internal enum ROUTE_DEGRADE with fallback_model_id and reason. We can expose a compact header + response field. Proposal: expose header `X-Redwood-Route: degrade` and in body `metadata.route = "degrade"` plus `metadata.fallback_variant = "lite"` (abstracted).

lee (devex): pls avoid raw model IDs in responses. For hosted we should expose human-friendly variant labels only ("lite", "compat", "cached"). If we must include an id, it should be hashed/obfuscated. :+1:

nav (eng-sre): telemetry side: tag traces with route_reason=degrade and fallback_variant=lite. Also emit metric `runtime.fallback.count` and `runtime.fallback.latency_ms`. Add trace sampling for any request that triggers fallback so we can debug quality regressions.

tam (eng-platform): wording suggestion for client surface: 1) header `X-Redwood-Route: degrade` 2) response envelope field: `{"status":"ok","route":{"kind":"degrade","variant":"lite"}}` 3) a top-level warning field only for verbose mode: `warning":"Response generated by fallback variant; quality may differ"`

maria (product): prefer soft phrasing — we should not use the word "error" or "fallback" prominently. Maybe use: "Result served from compatibility variant to maintain latency" in console copy. For API docs: explain semantics and retry guidance.

lee (devex): console UX: don't spam banners. Show a per-route badge: orange dot + label "degraded (compat)" and a hover tooltip: "Requests in this route use compatibility variant <percent> of the time". Then a small link to runbook. Also allow customers to opt-in to verbosity (show warnings in response).

nav (eng-sre): alerting rules: critical if fallback_rate > 20% sustained for 24h, warn if >5% for 6h. Telemetry tags: `route_reason`, `fallback_variant`, `fallback_rate_bucket` (0-1%,1-5%,5-20%,20%+).

tess (eng-runtime): implementation notes: runtime will set `route_reason` and `fallback_variant` on the trace and emit a counter. We can add an http header `X-RW-Fallback: lite` but only in dedicated/private; hosted customers get variant label only (no model id). We'll add a config flag `expose_route_headers: true|false` per customer.

sam (eng-platform): RFC snippet for API contract (for docs):
```
Headers:
  X-Redwood-Route: degrade|primary|cached
Response metadata snippet:
  "route": {"kind":"degrade","variant":"lite"}
Behavior:
  - degrade: response is valid but served by a lower-cost/compatible variant; clients SHOULD NOT retry by default.
  - primary: normal route.
```

maria (product): rollout plan: internal-only for 48h -> alpha for a few customers (opt-in) -> general availability. Need console telemetry surfaces before alpha.

lee (devex): dashboard metrics to add: `runtime.fallback.count`, `runtime.fallback.pct`, `runtime.fallback.latency.p50`, `runtime.fallback.latency.p95`. Chart default: 1w trend + per-route breakdown.

nav (eng-sre): add runbook check: if fallback_rate spikes and model-quality-regression alert also fires, auto-open a severity-2 ticket. Also we should add a nightly job that samples degraded responses and runs eval checks.

tess (eng-runtime): will add sampling hook and export sample ids to a secured bucket for QA. Sample rate = min(1000/day, 0.1% of fallback requests).

sam (eng-platform): one more UX/contract decision: do we return HTTP 200 with route metadata (preferred) or a 2xx+warning code? I vote 200 to avoid breaking clients.

maria (product): 200 + metadata + optional warning is the right balance. We'll draft docs language.

kb-bot (deploy-bot): Canary deploy of runtime change `route_reason` tagging completed in region us-west-2.

lee (devex): final checklist before alpha: docs snippet, header toggles, console badge, metrics in grafana, runbook link. I'll own the console bits.

nav (eng-sre): I'll own alerting and the nightly sampling job.

sam (eng-platform): I'll ship the RFC and small API contract PR. Please review within 48h.

maria (product): thanks — if we all agree on phrasing i can write the helptext and the short-runbook. Agreement?

sam (eng-platform): +1

tess (eng-runtime): +1

lee (devex): +1

nav (eng-sre): +1

maria (product): Great — moving to RFC -> alpha plan.
